A_position_residual.physical_interpretation: Direct correction to 3D joint Cartesian coordinates
A_position_residual.pros: Zero gradient conflict; directly aligns with MPJPE objective

C_acceleration_residual.cons: Extremely noisy (1/dt^2 noise amplification factor of 900)

D_multi_head_pos_vel.physical_interpretation: Joint prediction of position and velocity residuals
D_multi_head_pos_vel.pros: Simultaneously updates full Kalman state vector
D_multi_head_pos_vel.cons: Requires loss weighting hyperparameter lambda_v to balance position vs velocity gradients
